summary: Round Mountain lookout in Bland County, VA, near Bastian: in use by April 1930, a 100-foot steel tower by 1935; now listed as removed, with no site description found.

facts.design: 100-foot steel fire tower (1935 newspaper item quoted by Forest Lookouts)
facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts marks it Removed; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as Tower Gone

staffing.status: Lookout in the tower in April 1930; watchman on duty through the spring and summer months by 1935

events.note: Lookout in the Round Mountain tower reported fires in April 1930 (item dated April 26, 1930)
Two mountain fires near Bland Courthouse, sighted from the tower, reported controlled; area burned comparatively small
Watchman on duty during the spring and summer months; tower described as a 100-foot steel fire tower

evidence.supports: tower near Bastian: the access road built by the CCC leaves U.S. Route 21 west of Bastian
evidence.quote: This road, built by the CCC leaves U.S. route 21 about 1/4 mile west of Bastain

evidence.supports: design: 100-foot steel fire tower on top of the mountain (1935)
evidence.quote: on top of Round mountain is erected a 100-foot steel fire tower

evidence.supports: 1930 lookout in the Round Mountain tower reported two fires near Bland Courthouse, controlled
evidence.quote: two mountain fires sighted in the vicinity of Bland Courthouse by the lookout in the Round mountain tower yesterday morning have been controlled

evidence.supports: fires were threatening for a time
evidence.quote: The fires were for a time threatening
the area burned was comparatively small

evidence.supports: 1935: watchman on duty during spring and summer months
evidence.quote: where a watchman stays on duty during the spring and summer months

evidence.supports: the access road runs to the top of Round mountain, where the tower stands
evidence.quote: to the top of Round mountain

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts marks the tower removed
Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the Round Mountain tower as gone

notes_for_editor: No build date or builder found for the tower. The CCC credit in the 1935 item applies to the access road, not the tower, and the story says so. Removal date and cause not found. The 1930 and 1935 items are newspaper quotes as reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page; the originals (The Bee, Bluefield Daily Telegraph) were not checked. The brief's record matches both lists. Local NHLR and FFLOS caches have no entry for this site. Used 2 WebSearch calls and a handful of page reads (Forest Lookouts and the Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia list).
